metadata.title: Equation Population Reconciliation: Frozen Benchmark vs v16 Recovery Aggregate
metadata.purpose: Document both equation population sizes, source hashes, paper-level counts, and reconciliation status

count_definitions.reference_equation_count: Frozen benchmark uses reference_equation_count per paper - the original canonical extraction count from the frozen batch.
count_definitions.total_in_v16: v16 aggregate uses total per paper - the corrected recovery pipeline count that incorporates remediation fixes and additional extraction variants.
count_definitions.approximated_equation_identity: Until record-level reconciliation is complete, 'additional' means additional extracted records, not proven newly recovered equation variants. Deduplication and occurrence identity verification still pending.

record_level_identity.description: Individual equation occurrence identity verification is required to determine whether the 826 additional records for 2605.06070 are newly recovered equations, additional occurrences, or duplicates. Until verified, they are additional extracted records pending identity confirmation.
record_level_identity.need: record-level identity matches between frozen benchmark reference_equation_ids and v16 recovered entries

frozen_benchmark.definition: The canonical reference count per paper at the time of frozen batch creation (commit b877ca8d21, manifest 6091490b78184d388c3e80253600f79b7ffea76fad06cc589e52462a958f47b7).

v16_recovery_aggregate.definition: The corrected recovery pipeline count after remediation fixes. These counts may include equation variants not present in the original frozen reference counts for 2605.06070.

reconciliation_status.scope: Counts match for 13 of 14 papers. 1 paper (2605.06070) shows 826 additional records.
findings: Paper ID lists are identical - no duplication or omission
13/14 papers have zero delta - confirmed match
1/14 paper (2605.06070) has 826 records in v16 that are not in the frozen reference count
826 additional records not independently deduplicated or occurrence-identified
Whether these 826 are newly recovered equations, additional occurrences of the same equations, or duplicated data is UNVERIFIED
recommendations: Record-level reconciliation of 2605.06070: match frozen reference_equation_ids against v16 recovered entries using occurrence identity (source_sha256, equation_id, and content_sha)
Independently verify whether the 826 additional records are (a) newly recovered equations, (b) additional occurrences, or (c) duplicate data
Do not automatically interpret 826 as 826 unique equations
Track 3,409 and 4,235 as separate populations until deduplication is established
